native_frames.scope: Source metadata/art extraction only, not a native replacement test. Raw source kept private.

source_shape: Two vertically stacked partial rear-rim/rotor sections in one native16x24tile. Each has two broad opposed lobes; upper/lower poses are90degrees offset. Preserve this stacked silhouette rather than replace it with a generic single circular vent. Visible sections do not establish2independent game objects or mechanical parts.

palette.primary: y from TileColor on rotor/axial blade masses, despite glyph ColorString c
palette.detail: c on exposed rear housing arcs
palette.rule: No fixed baked metal/gold paint. Temporary gold key means housing ownership only. Both original palette roles retained.

native_state.broken: SpawnWithEffect Broken, native IActivePart breakage sensitivity/status and AnimatedMaterialGeneric operational check leave native static/default rendering while not operational. Do not force this broken object to spin.
native_state.physics_direction: S from Fan.Direction controls native air behavior. Source uses one fixed face/map tile set; this is not a four-way furniture camera or donor placement system.
native_state.power_warning: Inherited AnimatedMaterialGenericAlternate power-cut status tile remains native diagnostic/status fallback, not a new scenery appearance or authored animation.

findings: AnimatedMaterialGeneric.Render checks StatusOf(Fan)==Operational before changing tile; StatusOf passes actual ignore flags, including default false IgnoreBreakage.
IActivePart IsBreakageSensitive defaults true and GetActivePartStatus returns Broken when IsBroken and not ignored.
Broken handles RepairedEvent by removing the effect; source status/state/repair remains native, no new repair workflow or effects rendered.
native_code_study.scope: Read-only installed code metadata, not a native replacement test. Raw decompiled code retained privately.

construction.camera: One fixed cardinal face/map plane following source; no yaw, body turn or3/4perspective.
construction.source_supported: Stacked arcs, two opposed rotor lobes per visible section and90degree top/bottom pose offset read from all4actual native masks. Same housing in all phases.
construction.authored: Smooth airfoil lobe curves, shallow rear-rim thickness, restrained nicks and small axial join shading refine ambiguous pixels; no blade broken off or missing rim inferred solely from Broken name.
construction.rule: Fit one default-frame material pass, then rigidly transform only rotor material through native angular poses inside fixed vector coverage. Housing stays byte-identical; no independent generated casing per phase.

frame.rule: Same canvas/origin/physical scale and fixed centers for both visible sections/all4phases. No per-phase bounds fitting.
